messages.author: 09a2faedf0ab2b95
messages.subject: RGeo errors on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I'm currently creating a shiny app. The application works fine in my local machine with runApp(), but when deployed to shinyapps.io it fails.

Here is the relevant log entry.(The complete log is also attached):
2016-01-06T22:42:37.853147+00:00 shinyapps[76816]: Error in rgeos::gUnaryUnion(y) : No UnaryUnion in this version of GEOS

I belive this is caused by the rGeos package, which depends on  the GEOS C library. Older versions  of that library (prior to 2011) to do not have the gUnaryUnion method. This in turn causes the r package to fail. Updating the underlying C library in your servers should presumably fix the issue.

The rGeos package is quite important for any geographical work in R, so not being able to use it is inconvenient to many users. 

Any chance this can be fixed?

Additional info:

messages.author: 783b2971974f0279
messages.subject: Re: RGeo errors on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I get the same issue with my app. My investigation leeds me to the fact that the Unary Union is available only with an version of GEOS older than 3.3. Then, when I run ma app locally, the package information about rgeos says:

rgeos version: 0.3-15, (SVN revision 515)
 GEOS runtime version: 3.4.2-CAPI-1.8.2 r3921
 Linking to sp version: 1.2-1
 Polygon checking: TRUE 

 So the 3.4.2 version of GEOS is used here and it's OK. But when I check the shinyapps.io logs of my app, the rgeos information says:

2016-01-08T10:27:22.983422+00:00 shinyapps[74690]: rgeos version: 0.3-15, (SVN revision 515)
2016-01-08T10:27:22.983425+00:00 shinyapps[74690]:  GEOS runtime version: 3.2.2-CAPI-1.6.2 
2016-01-08T10:27:22.983426+00:00 shinyapps[74690]:  Linking to sp version: 1.2-1 
2016-01-08T10:27:22.983427+00:00 shinyapps[74690]:  Polygon checking: TRUE 

Indeed, it will be helpful to udpate the GEOS library used by shinyapps.io !

Thanks too 

Regards

Gaël
